# SingLinkVPN Open Source

Official public technical and research repository maintained by SingLinkLabs.

Canonical project page: https://singlinklabs.github.io/singlink-vpn-open-source/
Source repository: https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-vpn-open-source
Official Telegram community: https://t.me/singlinkvpn

## Open-source code (phase 2, 2026-11-12, Apache-2.0)

- SingLink Beta protocol (first generation, written from scratch in Go; internal security audit, 31 findings, all High and Medium fixed; third-party audit planned): https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-protocol
- First-generation SingLinkVPN client for Windows, macOS, Android and iOS (Flutter + Go): https://github.com/SingLinkLabs/singlink-vpn-app
- Lineage: the SingLink protocol evolved from SingLinkVPN's early versions and SingLink Beta to today's SingLink 2.0; the first-generation protocol and client carry forward its design principles (account-based permissions, device binding, security by design).
- The latest versions (SingLink 2.0 core, current official apps) are not yet fully public for security reasons; the open-source plan continues with further phases after security review.
